sections.title: Building & Researching
sections.description: Developing an end-to-end live holographic video conferencing testbed over private OpenAirInterface (OAI) 5G standalone networks, fusing synchronized Intel RealSense depth cameras into real-time 3D point clouds in Unity.

sections.title: Pursuing
sections.description: Master's in Computer Science at the University of Nebraska-Lincoln, specializing in wireless networks, multi-access edge computing, and reinforcement learning controllers.

sections.title: Mentoring
sections.description: Mentoring undergraduate Senior Design engineering teams on point cloud capture, transmission architectures, and real-time spatial computing integration.

sections.title: Open To
sections.description: Ambitious systems, startups & research. Always eager to exchange ideas on 0-to-1 engineering, distributed systems, and frontier AI tools.

sections.title: Reading & Exploring
sections.description: Diving into recent papers on semantic communication, point cloud compression (MPEG G-PCC / Draco), and high-velocity software engineering paradigms.

excites: Building high-performance holographic streaming systems that bring photorealistic volumetric video into real-time low-latency reality.
motto: Everyone is living life for the first time, be kind.
